segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for jumping on. I've got about 18 minutes before I need to finish the renewal packet for deal desk, so I want to use this for seat count, invoice split, and the July date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, works. We have 74 users today, and we're adding 12 support leads by May 6. Finance also wants the invoice split 60% headquarters and 40% Phoenix.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So 86 total seats, dashboard package included, and split billing. The quote I sent was $48 per seat per month on a 12-month term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you hold the $48 through the end of April? Our VP is out until the 25th, but she already approved the budget.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I can hold it through April 30. And sorry I missed your call yesterday afternoon; I was heads down reconciling the import so the account wouldn't duplicate. That's fixed now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No worries. Main thing is the go-live. We need July 1 because training starts the week after, July 8.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: July 1 is fine if signature is in by April 26. We can waive the $1,200 onboarding fee and schedule admin training for June 24 or 25.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Legal will ask to remove auto-renewal. Is that going to slow things down?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They can strike auto-renewal if payment stays annual upfront, net 30. That's been accepted before, so it shouldn't be a big lift.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send the revised quote and I'll review it with procurement at 3:30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can send it before lunch. For the review, 3:30 is tight; I'm blocked for end-of-month entries until four, but I can do 4:15 if that still works.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: 4:15 is fine. If the numbers match what we discussed, we should be able to turn it by Friday.
